    Profile

    Emmel is a shrine maiden from the Sephira Village in the Gula Belt Region. Known as the vessel of purification, she has the tenacity to endure the duty she is charged to bear, that being to safeguard the people from corruption. Though her heart is full of compassion for all humankind, she is a bit dense when it comes to her own love life.

    Origin: Gula Belt Region
    Gender: Female
    Height: 158cm
    Weight: 43kg
    Birthday: Jan 27
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Bright Knight
    Likes: Peace
    Hobbies: Sunbathing
    Illust: RINZO
    CV: 金子彩花
